packageRules.description: pnpm 11.12.0 self-installer regression breaks pnpm/action-setup in CI (integrity/undefined crash). Skip only that version; other pnpm updates allowed.

Every @nestjs/* package must move together. @nestjs/swagger@11 imports @nestjs/common/interfaces, which @nestjs/common@12 no longer exports, so a nest-monorepo major on its own is red no matter what — the swagger and jwt bumps have to arrive in the same PR. Grouping them also keeps the ESM-only v12 line from landing piecemeal.

Block TypeScript major bumps. TS7 ships the native (Go) compiler, whose JS API shim lacks getParsedCommandLineOfConfigFile — nest/tsc-based build toolchains crash on it. Re-enable deliberately once the toolchain supports TS7.

Block nanoid major bumps. nanoid is present only as a transitive dev dependency (vitest -> vite -> postcss), and postcss requires ^3.3.16 while nanoid v6 is ESM-only ("type": "module", engines node ^22||^24||>=26) — a major bump makes postcss unloadable. The pnpm-workspace override pins ^3.3.17 purely to carry the GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8 patch inside the v3 line; renovate must not retarget it.
